chunks: We have sent no apostle but that he should be obeyed by the will of God. If they had come to you after wronging themselves and asked forgiveness of God, and you had also asked forgiveness for them, they would surely have found God forgiving and merciful.
ai.seo_question: What is the role of the Prophet in seeking forgiveness for believers according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse establishes the theological basis for the obedience of the Prophet and the Imams, linking their authority directly to divine permission ('bi-idhnillah'). It highlights the dual mechanism of forgiveness: personal repentance combined with the intercession (shafa'ah) of the Prophet, reinforcing the concept of the Prophet as the mediator of divine mercy.
